label: Witness in the Rain
summary: A corporate accountant in Vesper City saw something she should not have. You have one night to get her across the city before three corporations find her.
title: Witness in the Rain
description: She walked into your office soaked through, with a data chip sewn into her coat. By midnight every corporate security team in Vesper wants her. By dawn she needs to be at the one court that still works.

chapterOutlines.title: Closing Time
chapterOutlines.outline: Hear her story, and get out of your office before the security teams arrive.

chapterOutlines.title: The Long Way Down
chapterOutlines.outline: Cross the street markets, the flooded underlevels and the people who owe you favors.

chapterOutlines.title: Dawn at the Courthouse
chapterOutlines.outline: Get her to the courthouse, and decide who to trust with the chip.

scene.location: Your office above a noodle bar in the Low Market
scene.summary: Eleven at night, rain on the window, neon through the blinds. The woman at your desk keeps looking at the door.

openThreads: Who told the corporations where she went?

npcs.name: Mei Sato
npcs.description: Found a second set of books, and the bodies they were hiding.
abilities: Knows how the corporations move money

npcs.name: Dex Okonkwo
npcs.description: Your landlord and the closest thing you have to a friend.
goals: Keep his bar out of corporate trouble
abilities: Can get anyone a ride, a meal or a fake ID by morning

relationships.label: Client
relationships.status: Has to trust you, and hates it
